description: This file contains validation functions for RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) resources in Kubernetes, including roles, cluster roles, role bindings, and subject validation.

methods.name: ValidateRBACName
methods.description: Validates RBAC resource names, ensuring they conform to path segment naming rules.

methods.name: ValidateRole
methods.description: Validates a Role object, including metadata and rules.

methods.name: ValidateRoleUpdate
methods.description: Validates an update to a Role object, including metadata changes.

methods.name: ValidateClusterRole
methods.description: Validates a ClusterRole object, including metadata, rules, and aggregation rules.

methods.name: ValidateClusterRoleUpdate
methods.description: Validates an update to a ClusterRole object, including metadata.

methods.name: ValidatePolicyRule
methods.description: Validates a PolicyRule, ensuring verbs, resources, and API groups are correctly specified.

methods.name: ValidateRoleBinding
methods.description: Validates a RoleBinding object, including metadata, role reference, and subjects.

methods.name: ValidateRoleBindingUpdate
methods.description: Validates an update to a RoleBinding, including metadata and roleRef.

methods.name: ValidateClusterRoleBinding
methods.description: Validates a ClusterRoleBinding object, including metadata, roleRef, and subjects.

methods.name: ValidateClusterRoleBindingUpdate
methods.description: Validates an update to a ClusterRoleBinding, including metadata and roleRef.

methods.name: ValidateRoleBindingSubject
methods.description: Validates a subject within a role binding, including name, kind, and API group.
